sourceDigest.algorithm: sha256 over default-JavaScript-sort repository-relative forward-slash (path, NUL, raw content, NUL) for every file under src/ plus package.json, package-lock.json, .node-version

acceptance.scope: Scaled-down in-process scripted runtime retained-state gate; not whole-process or default-limit memory acceptance.

scopeNotes: Registry assertions determine the gate; heap samples provide supporting evidence under these settings only.
Live providers, CLI, evaluation recorder and Python sidecar are not constructed in this gate.
Production periodic timers and execution-cache TTL expiry are not measured here; deterministic coverage is separate.
Connection, request-body and event-stream/backpressure stress have separate tests; this report is not their load measurement.
Role/evidence/review modes, model summaries, default-limit and whole-process memory bounds, and disk-backed history are outside this acceptance.
Fixed/rolling and account-wide cross-process quota reconciliation, shared deployment, independent quality and unattended worker recovery remain open.
Measured source was dirty at execution; before/after digest matches the accepted immutable source commit. Later startup-test and documentation edits do not affect this source digest.
Earlier measurement artifacts are preserved unchanged.
